items.statement: Produce one measurable exact proximal selector p satisfying p+eta*gradientV(p)=y. For literal rho(u)=V(p+sqrteta*u)-V(p)-sqrteta*inner(gradientV(p),u) and Q=normu^2/2+rho, produce C2, mode0, 0<=Hessrho<=etaI and I<=HessQ<=(1+eta)I. The actual RGO R=mu.tilted(-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta)) is a probability measure, and its actual standardized pushforward r equals volume.tilted(-Q). Genuine position and rho-gradient L2 satisfy integral normu^2 dr<=d and integral normgradrho^2 dr<=eta^2 integral normu^2 dr<=eta^2 d. Only the last TWO comparisons of(4.6) are covered; the first W2 comparison is open.
assumptions: Source beta=1, alpha=kappa^-1, real kappa>=1; actual C2 V with kappa^-1*normv^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=normv^2 for every x,v.

Finite real complete Hilbert/Borel full space E, including dimension zero, and arbitrary measurable parameter space S; measurable eta/y with every0<eta(s)<=1. These coordinate-free and parameter-space extensions are disclosed.

No supplied proximal point, law identity, normalizer, probability, curvature, gradient or moment certificate. Actual p, mu/R/r probability, normalized affine law, C2 curvature/mode and genuine position/Fisher L2 are internally produced. The numerical-prox eta<=1/(2beta) cap is a separate computational contract.

source_gaps.boundary: Printed density proportionality omits actual affine Lebesgue Jacobian eta^(d/2), inverse measurable map, finite positive partitions and normalization cancellation, including dimension0. Must produce, not assume.

Printed noncompact position IBP omits required actual weighted product integrability. The immutable initial source-gap inventory mentioned decay/cutoffs as a candidate route. The actual GibbsPositionMoment producer discharges the boundary through ordinary-volume L1 products and full-space Fubini/IBP, with no cutoff assumption or construction. The source theorem supplies neither an IBP nor a moment certificate.

Source omits measurable eta/y selector; reuse independently verified full_range_proximal_gaussian_oracle actual p, not a supplied point. Posterior joint Markov kernel measurability is separately OPEN.
FIRST4.6 inequality W2(r,gamma)<=sqrt Fisher is excluded; lasttwo squared inequalities give no W2/bias/MGF certificate.
